content.text: Reviewing pair 1: the key has two substantive components — the Key Person trigger (Orlev's death, 90-day incapacity, or ceasing to devote substantially all business time/ultimate responsibility) and the consequence package (5-Business-Day notice, redemption at either of the next two Redemption Dates on 10 days' notice free of lock-up and early redemption charge, subscriptions suspended). The answer reproduces the trigger accurately but omits the entire remedy, which is a required element of the provision.

pairs.note: Answer matches the key only on the Key Person Event trigger (Orlev's death, 90 consecutive days' incapacity, or ceasing to devote substantially all business time to and have ultimate responsibility for the Master Fund's program). It omits the key's required consequence element: written notice to Limited Partners within five Business Days, each LP's right to redeem as of either of the next two Redemption Dates on 10 days' notice without regard to lock-up and without early redemption charge, and suspension of subscriptions until then.
